decision_cruda.rationale: C512-10 has 136 t at 13.4 g/t (~58.6 oz) stranded; LH-01 repair likely 13:30 (range 12:30-14:30). Radio and CMMS agree, so a loan is allowed. LH-08 comes from the cheapest source, infrastructure heading DS-N600-01 (0.5 oz/h), and travel is 0.69 h. At 29.1 t/h the ore takes about 4.7 h, so it is cleared before 17:00. Central trucks have 91 t/h of capacity against 63 t/h of inflow, so Central is not truck-limited. Dev cost is about 0.5 x 5.4 h = 2.7 oz. Net is about 56 oz. LH-09 is on a preparation heading at 2.0 oz/h, so it stays. Reserves can't be activated because no stope is stopped.

Keep LH-08 at C512-10 (130 t at 13.4 g, LH-01 down until about 13:30). Lend LH-09 to N600-08 (165 t at 11.5 g, LH-02 down until about 13:40). Travel is 0.39 h. LH-09 can load about 73 t, roughly 27 oz, before LH-02 returns, against about 7.6 oz of lost development value at 2.0 oz/h. Net is about +19 oz. Norte trucks (66 t/h) are above inflow (42 t/h), so haulage is not the limit. Taking LH-07 or another producing loader gains about nothing net, since it would give up its own ore.

Keep both existing loans, since they already cover the stopes with failed home loaders (C512-10 at 13.4 g/t, N600-08 at 11.5 g/t). Their cost is low or justified: LH-08 costs 0.5 oz/h, and LH-09 costs 2 oz/h but loads about 8.7 oz/h. Covering E569-01 (LH-03 down, 319 t at 10.4 g/t) would need a loader from a producing stope or one of the loans. That only shifts production, and travel time makes it a net loss. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00, which is too late to help much. Radio and CMMS agree on all three failures, so no confirmations are needed. Repairs are likely at 12:50 to 13:40. Norte trucks are nearly saturated and Este has spare truck capacity, but no loader is free for Este without a loss elsewhere.
